web-guide-idea-77.audience: Beginners wanting to make one pickle correctly.
web-guide-idea-77.offer: Teach a specific recipe with attention to preparation and storage. Use prepared examples for stages that take longer than the class.
web-guide-idea-77.steps.0: Send the recipe and preparation requirements.
web-guide-idea-77.steps.2: Explain recipe-appropriate storage and what to observe over time.
web-guide-idea-77.equipment: A phone, stand and the recipe’s ingredients, clean utensils and containers.
web-guide-idea-77.returnReason: Run a different seasonal recipe or a follow-up on the completed batch.
web-guide-idea-77.promotion: Share the recipe style and preparation time, avoiding unsupported shelf-life promises.
